svg.title: Version I: new upstairs image study and current downstairs model
svg.desc: November 8, 2026. Editable Version I trace, adopted upstairs with a fixed-stair registration exception; Version H remains historical. Both panels use feet at 12 pixels per foot. Raster calibration is 224 pixels for the labelled 14 feet 8 inches primary width; source-image-not-measured-clearances do not fully reconcile. Downstairs follows shared geometry: living return z9.05 aligns its room face with kitchen counter z9.225; fireplace centers at z18; dining rear moves two feet to z1.9, retaining full height. Its side window narrows to four feet. Downstairs estimate is 1924.33 square feet including stairs; upstairs trace estimate is 2137.56 excluding its 92.74-square-foot stair block; combined trace estimate is 4061.89. These are arithmetic studies, not certified finished areas. Actual adopted upstairs retains the canonical stairs/44-inch arrival rather than the unregistered image stair outline, so its live area is 2153.35 and live combined area is 4077.69 square feet. The upstairs trace retains the pictured rooms, 96-inch door proxies and eighteen provisional openings /28 units. Main appliances, kids floor, ground guest suite and actual stairs are unchanged. No furniture or sanitary symbols are added to the SVG. Structure, roof alignment, fire separation, products, glazing, privacy, HVAC access, egress and occupied operation require professional review. Saved layout JSON is unchanged.

g.text: Room-boundary / centerline areas, not clear usable floor area. Upstairs values are image-trace estimates.
Wall figures are horizontal footprint, NOT vertical wall surface area or the whole wall footprint.
Interior walls and inward exterior-wall portions are already within the room allocations; do not add them again.
Downstairs: nominal 5.4-inch exterior walls / generally 4.2-inch garage separation. Upstairs: drawn 4.2-inch walls.
Wall assemblies are assumptions. Upstairs raster dimensions do not fully reconcile; hundredths are arithmetic precision only.
Stairs count downstairs only: 75.49 sq ft net. Upstairs's 92.74-sq-ft block is excluded; alignment remains unresolved.
Garage, porch and basement excluded. Conditioning, headroom and structure unverified; not certified finished/appraisal area.
Totals use unrounded trace geometry. Version H preserved; I adopted in 3D with fixed-stair exception and separately measured area.
